snippet.title: ANNO: Build an Empire - Android Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Now available at Google Play Store:
http://bit.ly/ANNO_Android_Download

Get ANNO now for your Android tablet or smartphone and become the greatest city planer of all time. Start with a small settlement and let it grow to be a mighty island empire. 

The island awaits you!
